headline: The Desk became the flagship again — real illustrations, reader-first articles, working reactions, open comments and site-wide presence — while Studio Pulse stopped overstating and 18 crawl defects were closed.

items.title: Real illustrations, generated at no extra cost
items.insight: The publisher never had an image model; 25 stories shipped a procedural card under an art caption. A local plan-covered worker plus hash-bound operator review restores real art.
items.evidence: 25 backfilled + reviewed; 1 regenerated for a brand mascot; ingest self-test 32/32

items.title: Articles rebuilt for readers
items.insight: Machinery outweighed the story; now headline, byline, art and short version come first, with receipts folded per fact.
items.evidence: 8 Desk gates pass; layout test added

items.title: Open comments with automatic filtering
items.insight: Anyone may post; borderline text is held, members are badged and featured.

items.title: Homepage lead and site-wide strip
items.insight: The flagship was 140 lines below the fold; now it leads the homepage and rides the header, claiming "Live" only when the cadence is measured daily.
items.evidence: module self-test 41/41, strip geometry gate green, zero CLS

items.title: Pulse and deploy beacons stopped overstating
items.insight: Solara read as actively forged after 93 idle days; a stranded-deploy alarm was stale; a one-page commit fetch published an undercount as healthy.

items.title: 736-load crawl: 5 P0 and 13 P1 defects
items.insight: A decorative sigil covered the mobile menu button on 134 pages and floating widgets covered content on 104+ loads — invisible to source review.
items.evidence: measured rects, CLS 0.419→0.003, 181 tap targets raised

items.title: Member newsletter repaired end to end
items.insight: Never deployed since April; now Brevo, working unsubscribe, postal address, and hardened against double sends.

items.title: Tests and a copy gate for public text
items.insight: A typo reached the homepage and two feeds with no spellcheck anywhere; nine core client scripts had no tests at all.
items.evidence: copy gate 41/41 self-test, 56 new unit tests

followUps: Release: build, receipts in 7 themes, build:check, staging, production.
Deploy comments migration + Worker (Worker before content lane for reactions).
Newsletter: set secrets, deploy functions, preview to founder@ before any member send.
Founder copy: "Coming soon"/TBD on six live game pages.
Leaderboard embed contrast; staging Worker observability.
blockers: Nothing in production yet — the entire S356 release is ahead.
